title: Chorus Fruit - Spawn
description:
Changes the behavior of chorus fruit to teleport you to your bed/spawn.

Also teleports any mobs attached to your lead!
body:
Changes the behavior of Chorus Fruit. Instead of teleporting you a few blocks away, it teleports you back to your bed, or if you have no bed- Spawn.

If you are holding a lead attached to a pet, mob, boat, it will also teleport with you. 

**How It Works**

The datapack creates an exit portal in the end at 0 0 0, when you eat the Chorus Fruit it teleports the player into it, which activates Vanilla Minecraft's respawn function.

Leashed mobs are temporarily moved to a holding area at at 0 -62 0 , then teleported to your final location within a second. The datapack creates a bedrock chamber at the bottom of the world.

_Because it relies on an End Exit Portal to take you home, if the player has not yet defeated the Ender Dragon, the credits will run the first time you use it._

_To ensure to the mobs actually make it back to the player, it keeps the chunk at 0 ~ 0 always active._
